name: Invincible Tank
detailed_description:
"Invincible Tank" has 400 types of land and air weapons including tanks, chariots, and helicopters. Join the battle with armed helicopters, and drive Apaches to harvest ground tanks! Bounces, explosions, belt breaks, armor penetration, restore the real battlefield experience! 2000x2000 grand battlefield, 12v12 hearty group battles, large maps with more people. Players will participate in 12v12 team competitions or flag-grabbing battles in a giant 2000x2000 battlefield, fast-paced hearty battles and team tactical cooperation.

Get ready for epic clashes with players from all over the world and show your strategic skills.

Download "Invincible Tank" now and conquer the battlefield like never before!

[Real Restoration]

1:1 real restoration, Tiger, Panther, T34, T72, T90, Leopard II, Centurion, AH64, M2 Bradley, AH1, Apache, Black Hawk, and more famous vehicles are waiting for you to drive! Experience the shooting feeling brought by war machines.

【Battle Mode】

You can choose single player, team, campaign mode, and multiplayer mode. Each mode has different ways to play and win. In a limited time, destroy as many enemies as possible and survive is the best way!

【Diverse Play Styles】

Each vehicle has a wealth of upgradeable accessories, including powerful output of tanks, flexible maneuvers of armored vehicles, aerial suppression of helicopters, and firepower coverage of rocket launchers. Take advantage of the terrain advantages of each map and experience the power of steel!

【National Team】

Fight against players from all over the world with your teammates, defend the base, and launch a counterattack. Remember, be resolute and resolute in battle, and be tenacious in failure!
